featured_reviews.review_text:
As a father of two children at Orchids International School - Kurla, my experience has been decent but with some concerns.

While the school has a good curriculum and infrastructure, there are areas that need improvement.

The Positives:

Qualified Teachers – Most teachers are caring and make efforts to engage students.

Good Facilities – The classrooms and playgrounds are well-maintained.

Extracurricular Activities – A decent variety of activities to keep kids interested.

Areas for Improvement:
Communication Gaps – Sometimes, updates about school events or academic progress are delayed or unclear.

Homework & Workload – My son often feels overwhelmed with assignments.

Limited Individual Attention

The school has potential but needs better communication, workload management, and more focus on individual student needs. Hoping for positive changes in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Mubarak Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took my advanced English-speaking course here recently, and overall, the experience was quite decent—especially considering the course cost over ₹15,000.

The trainers and the staff handling the training and photos were professional and polite, which I appreciated. The classes went smoothly, and when one student had an accident, the staff helped her quickly, which was great to see.

The centre itself is quite small, with a tiny waiting area, three speaking rooms, and one room for staff meetings. Even though the space is limited, the sessions were conducted smoothly.

The front desk staff often encouraged students to leave a Google review, which at times felt a bit frequent, but it also showed that they value feedback from students.

During the training, the coordinator was quite active in giving instructions and guiding the session. Sometimes the instructions were delivered very quickly, which made the listening and reading sections a little difficult to follow, but the session continued in an organized way.

Overall, it was a fairly decent experience. The training setup was good, the trainers were professional, and with a few improvements in coordination and student interaction, the overall experience could become even better.

Overall, a very okay-ish experience. The training setup was fine, but the staff attitude and environment could use a serious upgrade.
